newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC, Philipp Holzmann set up venture.
newsitem.headline: APC, Philipp Holzmann set up venture.

text.p: Philipp Holzman AG said it has established a joint venture construction company with Philippine firm the APC Group Inc, Holzmann said on Thursday.
In a statement, German-based Philipp Holzmann said the new company, Philipp Holzmann-APC Inc (PH-APC Inc), will have authorised capital of over 200 million pesos.

PH-APC Inc president David Kidd said in the statement that the joint venture firm is planning a 500-bed hospital, rehabilitation and new pumped storage hydro-electric plants as well as high-rise condominiums. Kidd is an official from Holzmann.
The statement did not say when the joint venture firm was formed. The APC group has interests in telecommunications, energy and cement.
